Yeah. Also, LLMs are specifically fine-tuned to work in specific harnesses and with specific tools.

I.e., the harness is part of the training setup, so the model can't really absorb it.

It’s a bit like the CPU/GPU absorbing the operating system.
posts.quoted: > A common idea floating around is that LLMs will absorb harnesses and make them obsolete. There is no way enough people believe this for it to be "common". x.com/a1zhang/status…
